message:
fix(capture-lifecycle r2): a frame is adopted only under its own provenance; one owner epoch per tick; a question never replaces a change; a reacquire budget per source

Codex SOURCE NEEDS_CHANGES N1-N4 on 569059f (codex_capture_lifecycle_src_r1.md).

N1  A frame carries its attachment's cookie; the attachment carries the desktop generation it was made under
    (stamped at DetachCaptureSession). PublishFrame adopts into the cache (under bootstrapCacheMu) and the raw
    queue (under res.frame.mu) only with both current -- the callbackUs rule is gone; the cache keeps the
    cookie and KickTryFill re-serves only the running attachment's. A confirmed edge closes the media fence
    first (input epoch, raw frame, key), then the running capture -- any backend -- is rebuilt because its
    attachment is stale: bounded per desktop generation, fail closed. An unknown look or a first look at
    another name is no edge but drops the cache and blocks caching (suspect); the first look sets the name only.
N2  host_backend_owner.hpp (pure): one epoch read per tick settles the owner; requests are taken under it
    (older dropped, newer LEFT for the next tick), marked with their own epoch. A real Serve end
    (backendSessionEndedEpoch) puts the owner's choice back once; an earlier owner's late end is ignored.
    Inactive / idle-detached: stored, no capture restart.
N3  DesktopBackendControl keeps a question apart from a waiting change (public API unchanged). The host
    answers 'applied' only once this session's status is published and its last change handled.
N4  The full-frame episode is keyed on (desktop gen, stream gen, session epoch, external attach boundary);
    its own reacquire keeps the budget; only a provenance-accepted frame closes it.
lib  A full-frame request is answered only by an acquire carrying an image (LastPresentTime != 0): r1 handed
     a pointer-only first acquire on as the full frame -- black (luma spread 0, content=0), found here.
Test-build seams: DxgiDesktopCaptureConfig::testStill (Still / StillNoFirstFrame -- the real duplication
remake runs), GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_DESKTOP_REBUILD_FAIL. New: PS --still-nofirst, UA --rebuild-fails,
remote60_host_backend_owner_test, shared_core backend question/change cases.

Product / test / docs: product (host provenance, edge fence, rebuild rule, backend owner, status answer,
reacquire episode; capture lib; shared client) / test (PS, UA modes, unit) / docs (history).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
